OpenStreetMap has no road named Sabarmati Ashram Road: the road that reaches the Sabarmati (Gandhi) Ashram is Ashram Road
no Usmanpura overbridge road lies on the re-anchored network; the id carries the real road west from the Indira Bridge's north end to Motera, state highway SH71 at its Motera end
segments.name_note: OpenStreetMap names little of the 4997 m path: 1204 m at the Motera end carry the ref SH71, 508 m a misspelt local name and the rest none; the segment is named for its state-highway ref and its two ends, as junction J30 (Bhat - Motera Road) is. OSM tags no lanes on any of its ways: the 4 lanes are the seed's own value for this id
